doc: Credentials for /prove's S3 board publish. Consumed by env_load_domain prove, sourced from skills/prove/assets/_prove-s3-env.sh.

The `default` column here IS the defaults that used to be hardcoded in _prove-s3-env.sh. BUCKET, REGION, PREFIX, ENDPOINT and PUBLIC_BASE default to the local MinIO started with the kit: bucket `proofs`, API on 127.0.0.1:9440, anonymous read on the proofs/ prefix. The start command and its bucket-verification step live in `~/Projects/kit/app/proofs/README.md` § `Publish here` and are not repeated here — a start that names the `proofs-minio` service, or omits `-p kit-app`, leaves a server answering on 9440 with no bucket and exits 0. PROFILE and USER carry NONE: on a loopback endpoint _prove-s3-env.sh takes credentials from AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, else from KIT_PROOFS_MINIO_USER/KIT_PROOFS_MINIO_PASSWORD (the login the kit's app/proofs/compose.yml starts MinIO with; no login is ever assumed), and the user segment from `id -un`. To publish to AWS S3 instead, set PROVE_S3_ENDPOINT=aws (an empty value does not shadow a default) and name a real bucket, region and (optionally) profile in the project .env.

Every row is `boards`, never `req`: env_load_domain must not abort the source on a missing bucket. publish.sh and publish-s3.sh each emit their own, better, bucket-specific guidance — a hard failure here would replace it with a worse one.

ENDPOINT is the destination identity, not BUCKET. Several local stores on this machine are named `proofs` and answer the same `proofs/` prefix, so a publish aimed at the wrong one succeeds and returns a URL serving another store — read the PORT. publish-s3.sh states the resolved endpoint before writing and refuses when the resolved port disagrees with the port the env FILE declares (prove_destination_gate in _prove-s3-env.sh).

credentials.how: S3 bucket for published boards. Defaults to `proofs` on the local MinIO started with the kit.
S3 region for board publish (MinIO accepts any; AWS S3 uses it for the virtual-hosted URL).
S3 key prefix for board publish

OPTIONAL AWS CLI profile for the upload. Leave unset for the local MinIO: credentials then come from AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY when set, else, when PROVE_S3_ENDPOINT is a 127.0.0.1/localhost URL, from KIT_PROOFS_MINIO_USER / KIT_PROOFS_MINIO_PASSWORD in the environment: the login the kit's `app/proofs/compose.yml` starts MinIO with, overridden in the kit's `app/.env` (see `~/Projects/kit/app/proofs/README.md` § Credentials). No login is assumed: with none of these set and no profile, the upload has no credentials and fails, naming these variables. Name a profile only when publishing to AWS S3.
Key prefix under the proofs bucket for board STATE objects (state-append.sh writes <prefix>/<doc>.json)
Key prefix for the append-only board EVENT objects that prove-sync.sh folds into state
OPTIONAL per-user key segment for published boards. Unset: `id -un` on a loopback endpoint, else derived from the AWS caller identity.

S3-compatible endpoint for publish. Defaults to the local MinIO started with the kit (start it per `~/Projects/kit/app/proofs/README.md` § `Publish here`). Set it to `aws` in a project .env to publish to AWS S3 with virtual-hosted URLs (an empty value does not shadow this default).

Base URL readers use for published objects (path-style: <base>/<bucket>/<key>). No default: it follows whichever PROVE_S3_ENDPOINT resolved, so a project .env that moves the endpoint cannot leave links pointing at a different store.
